observations.text: `Đang tải tin nhắn trước…` — `trước` can also parse as 'in advance'. Concur with the earlier NIT disposition (no change): three shipped siblings use the same words (Tải tin nhắn trước, Không tải được tin nhắn trước, Tìm trong tin nhắn trước), so a single-key rewording would create the drift it claims to fix.
`Đang kiểm tra tin nhắn mới…` renders 'checking for new messages' as kiểm tra + noun, the shipped pattern for 'checking for updates' (Đang kiểm tra bản cập nhật…, ui.browser.extensions). Calque-free.

English 'cancelled/stopped' collapses to `đã dừng`: truthful for both outcomes and consistent with this card's own item_status mapping (cancelled -> Đã dừng) and shipped ui.projects.project_model.stopped. Not read as an omission.
`mục {item}/{total}` keeps 'item X of Y' compactly without a calqued `của`; nothing lost, and it keeps the wrapping row short.
`Âm thanh được tạo` — noun + passive is right for a name; the status line `Đã tạo hình ảnh` is verb-initial by role. Agrees with the r3 INFO note: do not unify these later.

`Không rõ trạng thái` is three words against the sidecar's 'one or two words' hint. Cleared: the sidecar says the line wraps, there is no maxCells/maxChars hint in this namespace's sidecar, and the identical string ships in ui.ownerAudit.unknown_status.
